## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the applicable specification/task or
explain the maintenance scope.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. For product changes, distinguish automated, web,
physical Android and human review; record remaining gates as NOT RUN or BLOCKED.

## Review

- Confirm the exact file boundary and preserve other contributors' work.
- Explain any effect on Parent/Child access, approval, privacy, permanent growth or reset.
- For UI changes, include synthetic Arabic/English evidence and accessibility observations.
- Record AI assistance and actual human review according to CONTRIBUTING.md.
- Include no credentials, real Child data, unreviewed media or generated build output.
